data.name: Credits_Title
data.value: SpaceSharp is built on open work

data.name: Credits_Thanks
data.value: Thank you to the people behind it.

data.name: Credits_MapText
data.value: The layout is the squarified treemap from [Bruls, Huizing and van Wijk](https://www.win.tue.nl/~vanwijk/stm.pdf), published in 2000. The idea of showing a disk as a map is from [SpaceMonger](https://www.stardock.com/products/spacemonger/) by Sean Werkema, and treemaps themselves from Ben Shneiderman (1991). The color-blind-safe palette uses the eight [Okabe and Ito](https://jfly.uni-koeln.de/color/) colors (2002).

data.name: Credits_SoftwareText
data.value: Written in C# on [.NET 10](https://dotnet.microsoft.com). The interface is [Avalonia UI](https://avaloniaui.net), drawn with [SkiaSharp](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp), in the [Inter](https://rsms.me/inter/) typeface by Rasmus Andersson. Icons are from [Lucide](https://lucide.dev), continued from Feather by Cole Bemis. The Windows installer and updates come from [Velopack](https://velopack.io) by Caelan Sayler. All are MIT licensed except Lucide (ISC) and Inter (SIL Open Font License).

data.name: Credits_LanguagesText
data.value: Norwegian is the author's own; the other 16 translations are machine-made and still waiting for a native speaker's review. If something reads wrong in your language, [say so on GitHub](https://github.com/SpaceSharpApp/SpaceSharp/issues).

data.value: That scan was made differently ({0}) from this one ({1}). Files only one method can see, such as protected system folders, and hard links counted once by one method and in full by the other, will show as gone, new, grown or shrunk.

data.name: Dialog_CompareSelfMessage
data.value: That file is this scan's own save. Nothing can change between a scan and itself, however hard we look. Pick an earlier scan to see what did.
